headline: Why Use a Charter Broker
primaryText: Brokers know how each yacht and crew actually work. Tell us what you want from the week and we shortlist the yachts that fit.
whyItWorks: A real broker speaks straight to camera in a vertical, native-looking video, which feels more personal than a polished brand spot. The copy frames the broker as the expert who removes the guesswork, then makes the next step simple: say what you want from the week and get a shortlist. It is only a day old with under 100 impressions, so there is no performance signal yet.
